en.caption_text: Warning and Caution Symbols. Must read to alert individuals to potential hazards or risks.
Read the user manual before operation.
Keep the product away from fire.
This symbol indicates that a lithium-ion (Li-ion) battery is inside the product and should be disposed of or recycled properly.

This symbol indicates that the product shall not be disposed of as household waste, and should be delivered to a designated collection facility for recycling. Proper disposal and recycling can help protect the environment. For more information about the disposal and recycling of this product, contact your local community, disposal service, or dealer.

source_concerns.issue: space before the colon 「ranges :」; space before the closing bracket 「45°C )」 in both temperature lines (op.l2a, op.l2b)
「Ensure the device(s) are powered off before connecting it to the product」: plural subject with 「it」
comma splice 「depends on weather conditions, place your solar panel …」
「in accordance with all local codes ordinances」 (missing 「and」)

the ISED panel opens mid-sentence 「Development Canada's licence-exempt RSS(s).」 (the usual 「This device contains licence-exempt transmitter(s)/receiver(s) that comply with Innovation, Science and Economic …」 lead is missing)
car input 「11-16V⎓8A Max, Double to 8A Max」 (spec.i2.v1 「11V-16V⎓8A Max, Double to 8A Max」): the doubled value equals the single value, and the two places format the range differently
「AC 1 Power Button」 here and in body copy, 「AC1 Power Button」 in the key-combination table and 「AC1 and AC2」 on p10
「peak output reaches 12A before power outages」 next to 「reaches 15 A and sustains for at most three hours」; unit spacing 「12A」 vs 「15 A」 / 「12 A」
missing space 「Bypass Mode¹:100V」; 「Double to 21A Max/ 400W Max」 spacing (spec.i2.v2)
